descriptions: Survey among pupils of secondary schools with a great number of detailed questions about their living conditions, opinions and attitudes. Living conditions at school and at home / income / money spending / saving money / borrowing money / possessions / time spending / education / work / political preference and religious conviction / welfare / public opinion.
